user.title: Eastron / Victron / Chint gateway
user.description: How is this RS485 bus reachable from Home Assistant? You'll add the individual meters on this bus next.

network.title: Gateway connection
network.description: IP address/hostname and port of the RS485-to-network gateway.

data_description.wait_between_requests_ms: Minimum silence between two Modbus requests on this bus. Raise this if you see timeouts or garbled reads; 0 disables the pause.

serial.title: Serial connection
serial.description: The local serial device for your USB-RS485 adapter, and the serial settings configured on the meter(s) (Eastron default is usually 9600-N-1).

data_description.wait_between_requests_ms: Minimum silence between two Modbus requests on this bus. Raise this if you see timeouts or garbled reads; 0 disables the pause.

meter.title: Add a meter
meter.description: One meter on this RS485 bus.

data_description.scan_interval: Recommended: leave this at the default (30s) for normal monitoring and dashboards. Only lower it if you're feeding a zero-export or load-balancing controller that needs fresh readings every 3-5 seconds - and keep in mind this meter shares its RS485 bus with any other meters behind the same gateway, so speeding up one meter adds traffic for all of them. Going much below 3 seconds is not recommended.

add_another.title: Add another meter?
add_another.description: {count} meter(s) added so far. Add another meter on this same bus, or finish setup.

error.duplicate_unit_id: That Modbus address is already used by another meter on this bus.

abort.already_configured: This gateway (same connection settings) has already been added.

options.rtu_over_tcp: RS485-to-TCP gateway, transparent (e.g. Elfin EW11, USR-W610/TCP232)
options.tcp: Modbus TCP gateway, native (e.g. Waveshare RS485-to-ETH in Modbus TCP mode)
options.serial: Local serial port (USB-RS485 adapter directly on the HA host)
